# Brief

**Brand:** Weequb Technologies (demo values — see BRAND.md)
**Topic / goal:** Demo Reel that shows what the Weequb Reels workflow produces
**Target length:** 16 s
**Hook (first 1.5 s):** "Stop scrolling!" over the fastest-moving visual
**Key message / CTA:** Raw clips in → scroll-stopping Reels out. CTA: "DM us to start."
**Footage provided:** generated by `scripts/demo_assets.py` — fractal zoom (hook), landscape "raw footage", brand-colour gradient, music waveform, phone mockup still, logo end card
**Voiceover:** none — on-screen captions carry the script
**Music:** `raw/music.wav`, 120 BPM electronic loop
**Caption style:** pop (BRAND.md default)
**Must include / must avoid:** show the blurred-background fill on the landscape clip, one Tamil line, end on the logo card

---

## On-screen script (timed to the music, 120 BPM = a beat every 0.5 s)

| Time | Shot | Caption |
|---|---|---|
| 0.0–1.5 | fractal zoom | STOP SCROLLING! |
| 1.5–4.0 | landscape "raw footage" (blur fill) | Raw clips in. |
| 4.0–6.0 | fractal zoom, punch-in | Scroll-stopping Reels out. |
| 6.0–8.5 | music waveform | Every cut on the beat. |
| 8.5–11.0 | phone mockup | Captions in your brand style. |
| 11.0–13.5 | brand gradient | English. தமிழ். Tanglish. |
| 13.5–16.5 | logo end card | DM us to start. |
